swap_trigger.recheck_rule: act on this bar: the one-off part of 6,170 CNY is unmeasured -- no comparable episode in the panel ever healed, so nothing here says the window waits. After execution the only number that can bring the decision back is the toll of the exchange it would have to make: re-read this face on the next decision bar, and act again only if a pair's gap exceeds 0.16 pp (2 sides x 8 bp). Getting the book back where it came from pays that same exchange once more, so the whole manoeuvre is 0.32 pp (4 sides) -- that number answers 'did the discount pay for the trip', never 'may I act'.
caveats: the trigger is priced in pp of notional and compared against the toll of ONE exchange (0.16 pp, 2 sides) only; the whole manoeuvre (0.32 pp, 4 sides) is published next to it and is never the threshold.
